Remark
[Hyperbolic proof of primitivity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0201 1. ch31:31.17\group 3-manifold topology

On a closed hyperbolic surface uniqueness of geodesic representatives gives a second proof: a simple geodesic cannot be a nontrivial power.
